title: submit() payload
description: Canonical form of a submission. The matcher additionally normalises before matching (type: strip+lower, currency: strip+upper, ids: strip; a doc_id in affected_ids maps to its business id, a business id in evidence_ids to its doc_id), so it also accepts non-canonical spellings; everything valid here is valid for the matcher. A structurally invalid submission ends the episode with reward -1. Amounts are in the functional currency (manifest.base_currency). Reward never depends on explanation.

id.description: Non-blank id string of at most 64 characters.

affected_ids.description: duplicate_invoice: both invoice_ids; payment_allocation: [payment_id, invoice_id]; fx_error: [invoice_id] or [payment_id]; period_cutoff: [invoice_id]. Compared as a set.

claimed_amount_minor.description: Absolute misstatement in functional-currency minor units; tolerance 1.

evidence_ids.description: Records that together prove the issue (documents, booking rows, the policy fx row). TP needs one admissible evidence set to be a subset.
